description: Source code for MediaTransform class handling media processing using Windows Media Foundation APIs, including methods for input/output processing, configuration, and state management.

classes.name: MediaTransform
classes.description: Class managing media transformation using Windows Media Foundation, including input/output handling, configuration, and state control.

methods.name: TryWrite
methods.description: Attempts to process an input sample into the media transform.

methods.name: TryRead
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve processed output sample from the media transform.

methods.name: Drain
methods.description: Signals the media transform to process remaining data and end streaming.

methods.name: draining
methods.description: Checks if the transform is in draining state.

methods.name: drained
methods.description: Checks if the transform has finished draining.

methods.name: HasError
methods.description: Checks if the transform is in an error state.

methods.name: HasValidTransform
methods.description: Checks if the transform object is valid.

methods.name: ResetFromDrained
methods.description: Resets the transform state after draining.

methods.name: GetCurrentInputType
methods.description: Retrieves the current input media type.

methods.name: SetInputType
methods.description: Sets the input media type.

methods.name: GetAvailableInputTypes
methods.description: Retrieves all available input media types.

methods.name: GetCurrentOutputType
methods.description: Retrieves the current output media type.

methods.name: SetOutputType
methods.description: Sets the output media type.

methods.name: GetAvailableOutputTypes
methods.description: Retrieves all available output media types.

methods.name: SetOutputTypeBySubType
methods.description: Sets output type matching a specific subtype GUID.

methods.name: GetAttributes
methods.description: Retrieves transform attributes.

methods.name: GetOutputStreamAttributes
methods.description: Retrieves output stream attributes.

methods.name: GetSampleProtection
methods.description: Retrieves sample protection interface.

methods.name: GetStreamCount
methods.description: Retrieves number of input and output streams.

methods.name: SendMessage
methods.description: Sends a message to the transform.

methods.name: GetTransformCreateError
methods.description: Returns error message if transform creation failed.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the transform to initial state.

methods.name: PrepareOutputDataBuffer
methods.description: Prepares output buffer for processing.

methods.name: ProcessOutput
methods.description: Processes and retrieves output sample.
